quotes.text: Your ability to concentrate single-mindedly on your most important task determines your success.
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.text: Eat that frog! If you have to eat a live frog, do it first thing in the morning and nothing worse will happen to you the rest of the day.
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.text: The hardest part of any important task is getting started on it in the first place. Once you actually begin work on a valuable task, you seem to be naturally motivated to continue.
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.text: Discipline is doing what you need to do, even when you don't feel like it.
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.text: If you don't design your own life plan, chances are you'll fall into someone else's plan. And guess what they have planned for you? Not much.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: Either you run the day, or the day runs you.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: Success is nothing more than a few simple disciplines, practiced every day.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: Don't wish it were easier; wish you were better.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.text: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.text: People often say that motivation doesn't last. Well, neither does bathing—that's why we recommend it daily.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.text: You were born to win, but to be a winner, you must plan to win, prepare to win, and expect to win.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.text: Lack of direction, not lack of time, is the problem. We all have twenty-four hour days.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.text: You do not rise to the level of your goals. You fall to the level of your systems.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: The only way to become excellent is to be endlessly fascinated by doing the same thing over and over. You have to fall in love with boredom.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Small habits don't add up. They compound.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: The first step toward change is awareness. The second step is acceptance.
quotes.author: Nathaniel Branden

quotes.text: Productivity is never an accident. It is always the result of a commitment to excellence, intelligent planning, and focused effort.
quotes.author: Paul J. Meyer

quotes.text: Focus on being productive instead of busy.
quotes.author: Tim Ferriss

quotes.text: The key is not to prioritize what's on your schedule, but to schedule your priorities.
quotes.author: Stephen Covey

quotes.text: Action is the foundational key to all success.
quotes.author: Pablo Picasso

quotes.text: Things which matter most must never be at the mercy of things which matter least.
quotes.author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

quotes.text: Whatever the mind can conceive and believe, it can achieve.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.text: Don't wait. The time will never be just right.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.text: Effort only fully releases its reward after a person refuses to quit.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.text: Accept responsibility for your life. Know that it is you who will get you where you want to go, no one else.
quotes.author: Les Brown

quotes.text: Shoot for the moon. Even if you miss, you'll land among the stars.
quotes.author: Les Brown

quotes.text: You don't get in life what you want; you get in life what you are.
quotes.author: Les Brown

quotes.text: The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: Amateurs sit and wait for inspiration, the rest of us just get up and go to work.
quotes.author: Stephen King
